name: Abyssal Tiefling
reviewNotes: Inherits Fiend (Native), normal biological needs, Low-Light Vision and Thaumaturgy from species.tiefling.
Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma when selecting this ancestry. The choice governs all granted Tiefling spells, including Thaumaturgy.
Level 3 and level 5 spells have independent once-per-Long-Rest free castings; appropriate spell slots can be used additionally.
No mandatory cultural Upbringing or language; relative benefit and spell balance remain subject to playtesting.

Approved Abyssal package: Abyssal Fortitude grants floor(character level / 2), minimum 1, bonus maximum Hit Points; Poison Tolerance grants Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition; Potent Venom reduces effective Poison resistance by 25 percentage points for Poison damage dealt by this character, without affecting immunity or stacking with itself.

Trial pricing: Abyssal Fortitude 2, Poison Tolerance 1, Potent Venom 2, bringing Abyssal from 13 to 18 of 18. The existing Poison resistance, spell grants, and shared Tiefling foundation remain unchanged.
